specs.label: Video output
specs.value: 1x HDMI 2.0 (Type A) loop-through, SD up to 4Kp60

specs.label: Encoding
specs.value: Simultaneous HEVC and H.264 encoding of up to 2x independent channels (up to 1080p60 per channel); up to 1x 4Kp60 stream

specs.label: Output streams
specs.value: Up to 4x with independent resolution, frame rate and bit rate

specs.label: HEVC
specs.value: Main/Main 10 and Main 4:2:2, level up to 5.2; 36Kbps to 80Mbps; CIF up to 3840x2160p60

specs.label: H.264
specs.value: Baseline L3, Main L3/L4, High L4/L4.2; 64Kbps to 80Mbps; CIF up to 3840x2160p60

specs.label: Audio input
specs.value: HDMI and SDI embedded audio; analog unbalanced audio (stereo and mono)

specs.label: Audio encoding
specs.value: Up to 32x channels; MPEG-4 AAC-LC and AAC-ELD; AC-3 and E-AC-3 passthrough

specs.label: HDR
specs.value: HDR10 (SMPTE ST 2084/ITU-R BT.2100); HLG from SDI (SMPTE ST 2108)

specs.label: Network protocols
specs.value: UDP TS, RTP TS, RTP ES (RTSP), Zixi, ProMPEG FEC (SMPTE 2022), SRT, RIST, SPRINT, RTMP/RTMPS, HTTPS, SSH, NTP, PTP
